- path: assets\css\tracker.css
  content: |
      /* ==========================================================================
         CareerDesk — Study Tracker Module: Timers, 24h Activity Log, Heatmap & Onboarding
         ========================================================================== */
      
        /* ==========================================================================
           Study Activity Consistency Heatmap (GitHub Style)
           ========================================================================== */
        .heatmap-stats {
          display: flex;
          gap: 8px;
          flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
      
        .heatmap-stat-pill {
          display: inline-flex;
          align-items: baseline;
          gap: 6px;
          padding: 6px 12px;
          border-radius: 10px;
          background: var(--surface);
          border: 1px solid var(--border);
        }
      
        .heatmap-stat-pill .stat-num {
          font-family: var(--font-display);
          font-weight: 800;
          font-size: 16px;
          color: var(--accent2);
          letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }
      
        .heatmap-stat-pill .stat-lbl {
          font-size: 11px;
          font-weight: 600;
          color: var(--text-soft);
          text-transform: uppercase;
          letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }
      
        .heatmap-scroll-wrap {
          overflow-x: auto;
          padding: 4px 0 10px;
          -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
        }
      
        .heatmap-grid {
          display: inline-flex;
          gap: 4px;
          min-width: 100%;
        }
      
        .heatmap-col {
          display: flex;
          flex-direction: column;
          gap: 4px;
        }
      
        .heatmap-col-header {
          font-size: 10px;
          color: var(--text-muted);
          font-weight: 600;
          height: 14px;
          line-height: 14px;
          text-align: center;
          margin-bottom: 2px;
        }
      
        .heatmap-cell {
          width: 14px;
          height: 14px;
          border-radius: 3.5px;
          background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
          border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
          cursor: pointer;
          transition: transform 0.12s ease, border-color 0.12s ease;
          position: relative;
        }
      
        .heatmap-cell:hover {
          transform: scale(1.35);
          z-index: 5;
          border-color: #ffffff;
        }
      
        .heatmap-cell.lvl-0 {
          background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
        }
      
        .heatmap-cell.lvl-1 {
          background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.28);
          border-color: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.4);
        }
      
        .heatmap-cell.lvl-2 {
          background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.55);
          border-color: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.7);
        }
      
        .heatmap-cell.lvl-3 {
          background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.82);
          border-color: var(--accent1);
        }
      
        .heatmap-cell.lvl-4 {
          background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00e5ff, #6366f1);
          border-color: #ffffff;
          box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.45);
        }
      
        html[data-theme="light"] .heatmap-cell.lvl-0 {
          background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
          border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
        }
      
        html[data-theme="light"] .heatmap-cell.lvl-1 {
          background: rgba(8, 145, 178, 0.25);
        }
      
        html[data-theme="light"] .heatmap-cell.lvl-2 {
          background: rgba(8, 145, 178, 0.52);
        }
      
        html[data-theme="light"] .heatmap-cell.lvl-3 {
          background: rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.8);
        }
      
        html[data-theme="light"] .heatmap-cell.lvl-4 {
          background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0891b2, #4f46e5);
        }
      
        .heatmap-footer {
          display: flex;
          justify-content: space-between;
          align-items: center;
          flex-wrap: wrap;
          gap: 8px;
          margin-top: 10px;
          font-size: 11.5px;
          color: var(--text-soft);
        }
      
        .heatmap-legend {
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          gap: 4px;
          font-size: 11px;
          color: var(--text-muted);
        }
      
        .heatmap-legend .heatmap-cell {
          cursor: default;
        }
        .heatmap-legend .heatmap-cell:hover {
          transform: none;
        }
      
        /* Routine Empty State Card */
        .routine-empty-card {
          padding: 36px 20px;
          text-align: center;
          border-radius: 16px;
          background: var(--surface);
          border: 1px dashed var(--border);
          margin: 10px 0;
        }
      
        .routine-empty-icon {
          width: 48px;
          height: 48px;
          border-radius: 14px;
          background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.12);
          color: var(--accent1);
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          margin: 0 auto 12px;
        }
      
        .routine-empty-icon svg,
        .routine-empty-icon .lucide {
          width: 24px;
          height: 24px;
        }
      
        .routine-empty-card h4 {
          font-family: var(--font-display);
          font-size: 16px;
          margin: 0 0 6px;
          color: var(--text);
        }
      
        .routine-empty-card p {
          font-size: 13px;
          color: var(--text-soft);
          margin: 0 auto 18px;
          max-width: 420px;
          line-height: 1.45;
        }
      
        .routine-empty-actions {
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          gap: 10px;
          flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
      
        /* Header Actions */
        .header-actions,
        .brand-actions,
        .watch-actions {
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          gap: 8px;
          flex-shrink: 0;
          flex-wrap: nowrap;
          border: none;
          padding: 0;
        }
      
        .icon-action-btn,
        .watch-action {
          width: 38px;
          height: 38px;
          border-radius: 12px;
          background: var(--surface);
          border: 1px solid var(--border);
          color: var(--text-soft);
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          cursor: pointer;
          position: relative;
          padding: 0;
          transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
          backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
          -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
        }
      
        .icon-action-btn i[data-lucide],
        .icon-action-btn svg,
        .watch-action i[data-lucide],
        .watch-action svg {
          width: 17px;
          height: 17px;
          color: inherit;
          stroke: currentColor;
          transition: transform 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
        }
      
        .icon-action-btn:hover,
        .watch-action:hover {
          background: var(--surface-hover);
          border-color: var(--accent1);
          color: var(--text);
          transform: translateY(-1px);
          box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.22);
        }
      
        .icon-action-btn:active,
        .watch-action:active {
          transform: scale(0.94);
        }
      
        html[data-theme="light"] .icon-action-btn,
        html[data-theme="light"] .watch-action {
          background: var(--surface);
          border-color: var(--border);
          color: var(--text-soft);
        }
      
        html[data-theme="light"] .icon-action-btn:hover,
        html[data-theme="light"] .watch-action:hover {
          background: #ffffff;
          border-color: var(--accent1);
          color: var(--accent1);
          box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.16);
        }
      
        .watch-action:focus-visible,
        .icon-action-btn:focus-visible {
          outline: 2px solid var(--accent1);
          outline-offset: 2px;
        }
      
        .timer-mode-selector {
          display: inline-flex;
          align-items: center;
          gap: 4px;
          margin-top: 10px;
          padding: 4px;
          border: 1px solid var(--border);
          border-radius: 14px;
          background: var(--surface-strong);
        }
      
        .timer-mode-chip {
          min-width: 82px;
          padding: 7px 14px;
          border: 0;
          border-radius: 10px;
          background: transparent;
          color: var(--text-soft);
          cursor: pointer;
          font: 700 12px var(--font-sans);
        }
      
        .timer-mode-chip.active {
          background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent1), var(--accent2));
          color: #fff;
          box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.2);
        }
      
        .timer-duration-selector {
          display: flex;
          justify-content: center;
          gap: 6px;
          margin-top: 8px;
          flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
      
        .timer-duration-group {
          display: flex;
          justify-content: center;
          gap: 6px;
          flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
      
        .timer-duration-group[hidden] {
          display: none;
        }
      
        .session-row[hidden],
        .timer-duration-selector[hidden] {
          display: none !important;
        }
      
        #breakDurationOptions .chip.active {
          background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold), var(--accent3));
        }
      
        .routine-view-btn {
          min-width: 118px;
          justify-content: center;
        }
      
      
        /* ===== Tracker ===== */
        .tracker-top {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(0, 0.85fr);
          align-items: stretch;   /* ← FIX: forces both cards to equal height */
          gap: 18px;
          margin-bottom: 22px;
        }

          href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Outfit:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap"
          rel="stylesheet">
        <!-- Master Design System Stylesheet (Project File) -->
        <link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/css/master.css">
      
        <!-- Firebase SDK (Compat) for Native Web Authentication & Cloud Sync -->
        <script defer src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-app-compat.js"></script>
        <script defer src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-app-check-compat.js"></script>
        <script defer src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth-compat.js"></script>
        <script defer src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-firestore-compat.js"></script>
      
        <!-- Screenshot layout alignment overrides (must load after all inline styles) -->
        <link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/css/figma-layout-alignment.css?v=8">
        <link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/css/mobile-experience.css">
      </head>
      
      <body>
      
        <div class="aurora"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
      
        <header class="main-header masthead">
          <a href="#" class="brand-container brand" aria-label="CareerDesk Home" onclick="activateTab('home', true); return false;">
            <div class="brand-mark brand-badge" aria-label="CareerDesk logo">
              <img src="assets/icons/favicon.svg" alt="CareerDesk logo" class="careerdesk-logo" width="38" height="38">
            </div>
            <span class="brand-title">CareerDesk</span>
          </a>
      
          <!-- Nav Menu Pills -->
          <nav class="tabs nav-menu" role="tablist" aria-label="Primary Navigation">
            <button class="tab-btn nav-link active" data-tab="home" role="tab" aria-selected="true" title="Dashboard — Overview &amp; Analytics"
              aria-label="Dashboard"><i data-lucide="layout-dashboard"></i><span>Dashboard</span></button>
            <button class="tab-btn nav-link" data-tab="routine" role="tab" aria-selected="false" title="Rutine — Daily Study Routine &amp; Schedule"
              aria-label="Rutine"><i data-lucide="calendar-days"></i><span>Rutine</span></button>
            <button class="tab-btn nav-link" data-tab="tracker" role="tab" aria-selected="false" title="Tracker &amp; Focus"
              aria-label="Tracker"><i data-lucide="timer"></i><span>Tracker</span></button>
            <button class="tab-btn nav-link" data-tab="quiz" role="tab" aria-selected="false" title="BCS &amp; Govt MCQ Practice"
              aria-label="Quiz"><i data-lucide="brain"></i><span>Quiz</span></button>
            <button class="tab-btn nav-link" data-tab="countdown" role="tab" aria-selected="false" title="Exam Targets"
              aria-label="Exam Targets"><i data-lucide="calendar-clock"></i><span>Exams</span></button>
            <button class="tab-btn nav-link" data-tab="syllabus" role="tab" aria-selected="false" title="Syllabus"
              aria-label="Syllabus"><i data-lucide="list-checks"></i><span>Syllabus</span></button>
            <button class="tab-btn nav-link" data-tab="groupchat" role="tab" aria-selected="false" title="Group Chat"
              aria-label="Group Chat"><i data-lucide="messages-square"></i><span>Chat</span></button>
      
          </nav>
      
          <!-- Top Bar: Search and theme -->
          <div class="topbar" aria-label="Top controls">
            <div class="nav-search-btn" id="commandPaletteBtn">
              <i data-lucide="search" aria-hidden="true"></i>
              <input id="paletteSearchInput" type="search" role="combobox" aria-label="Search commands and syllabus" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="paletteResults" placeholder="Search commands, topics, and tabs..." autocomplete="off">
              <kbd class="nav-search-kbd">Alt + /</kbd>
              <button class="icon-action-btn watch-action topbar-shortcuts-btn" id="shortcutsHelpBtn" type="button" title="Keyboard Shortcuts (?)" aria-label="Keyboard Shortcuts">
                <i data-lucide="keyboard"></i>
              </button>
            </div>
            <div class="topbar-search-results" id="commandPaletteResults" hidden>
              <div class="palette-body" id="paletteResults" role="listbox" aria-label="Search results"></div>
              <div class="palette-footer">
                <span><kbd>↑</kbd><kbd>↓</kbd> Navigate</span>
                <span><kbd>↵</kbd> Select</span>
                <span><kbd>ESC</kbd> Close</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="topbar-clock" aria-label="Local time">
              <time id="topbarClockTime">--:--</time>
            </div>
          </div>
      
          <div class="sidebar-tools-label" aria-hidden="true">TOOLS</div>
      
          <!-- Header Actions (Figma Style) -->
          <div class="header-actions brand-actions watch-actions" aria-label="Quick controls">
            <button class="tab-btn nav-link sidebar-profile-link" data-tab="profile" type="button" title="Profile" aria-label="Profile">
              <i data-lucide="user"></i><span>Profile</span>
            </button>
            <button class="tab-btn nav-link sidebar-subjects-link" data-tab="subjects" type="button" title="Subject Manager" aria-label="Subject Manager">
              <i data-lucide="layers"></i><span>Subject Manager</span>
            </button>
            <button class="tab-btn nav-link sidebar-settings-link" data-tab="settings" type="button" title="Settings &amp; Sync" aria-label="Settings and sync">
              <i data-lucide="settings-2"></i><span>Settings &amp; Sync</span>
            </button>
            <button class="icon-action-btn watch-action" id="watchFullscreenToggle" type="button" title="Enter fullscreen" aria-label="Toggle Fullscreen" style="display:none;">
              <i data-lucide="maximize"></i>
            </button>
          </div>
        </header>
      
        <nav class="mobile-dock" aria-label="Mobile navigation">
          <button class="tab-btn nav-link" data-tab="home" type="button" aria-label="Dashboard" aria-current="page">
            <i data-lucide="layout-dashboard" aria-hidden="true"></i><span>Home</span>
          </button>
          <button class="tab-btn nav-link" data-tab="routine" type="button" aria-label="Routine">
            <i data-lucide="calendar-days" aria-hidden="true"></i><span>Routine</span>
          </button>
          <button class="tab-btn nav-link" data-tab="tracker" type="button" aria-label="Focus tracker">
            <i data-lucide="timer" aria-hidden="true"></i><span>Focus</span>
          </button>
          <button class="tab-btn nav-link" data-tab="quiz" type="button" aria-label="Quiz">
            <i data-lucide="brain" aria-hidden="true"></i><span>Quiz</span>
          </button>
          <button class="tab-btn nav-link" data-tab="syllabus" type="button" aria-label="Syllabus">
            <i data-lucide="list-checks" aria-hidden="true"></i><span>Syllabus</span>
          </button>
          <button class="mobile-more-trigger" id="mobileMoreTrigger" type="button" aria-label="More sections" aria-controls="mobileMoreMenu" aria-expanded="false">
            <i data-lucide="ellipsis" aria-hidden="true"></i><span>More</span>
          </button>
        </nav>
      
        <nav class="mobile-more-menu" id="mobileMoreMenu" aria-label="More sections" hidden>
          <button class="tab-btn mobile-more-link" data-tab="countdown" type="button">
            <i data-lucide="calendar-clock" aria-hidden="true"></i><span>Exam targets</span>
          </button>
          <button class="tab-btn mobile-more-link" data-tab="groupchat" type="button">
            <i data-lucide="messages-square" aria-hidden="true"></i><span>Group chat</span>
          </button>
          <button class="tab-btn mobile-more-link" data-tab="profile" type="button">
            <i data-lucide="user" aria-hidden="true"></i><span>Profile</span>
          </button>
          <button class="tab-btn mobile-more-link" data-tab="subjects" type="button">
            <i data-lucide="layers" aria-hidden="true"></i><span>Subject manager</span>
          </button>
          <button class="tab-btn mobile-more-link" data-tab="settings" type="button">
            <i data-lucide="settings-2" aria-hidden="true"></i><span>Settings &amp; sync</span>
          </button>
        </nav>
      
        <main>
          <datalist id="appSubjectDatalist"></datalist>
      
          <!-- ===== HOME / DASHBOARD (Figma node-id=3-2 Design) ===== -->
          <section class="panel active" id="panel-home">
      
            <div class="db-shell" id="dashboardOverview">
      
              <!-- Daily quote ticker -->
              <section class="home-quote-command quote-command-v2" id="homeQuoteCommand">
                <div class="profile-quote-ticker-top quote-command-v2-stage" id="profileHeroQuoteTicker">
                  <div class="profile-quote-ticker-content">
                    <div class="profile-quote-mark-badge quote-command-v2-mark"><i data-lucide="quote"></i></div>
                    <div class="profile-quote-typing-area quote-command-v2-copy">
                      <span class="profile-quote-phrase"><span class="profile-quote-curly-open">“</span><span class="profile-quote-typed-text" id="profileQuoteTypedText"></span><span class="profile-quote-cursor" id="profileQuoteCursor"></span><span class="profile-quote-curly-close">”</span></span>
                      <span class="profile-quote-author-pill" id="profileQuoteAuthorPill">— CareerDesk</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="profile-quote-controls quote-command-v2-controls">
                    <button type="button" class="profile-quote-lang-badge quote-command-v2-language" id="profileQuoteLangBadge" title="Switch quote language"><span class="lang-indicator-dot"></span><span id="profileQuoteLangText">EN</span></button>
                    <button type="button" class="profile-quote-ctrl-btn" id="btnToggleQuotePause" title="Pause / Resume"><i data-lucide="pause"></i></button>
                    <button type="button" class="profile-quote-ctrl-btn btn-cycle-profile-hero-quote" title="Next quote"><i data-lucide="skip-forward"></i></button>
                  </div>
                  <div class="profile-quote-progress-bar quote-command-v2-progress"><div class="profile-quote-progress-fill" id="profileQuoteProgressFill"></div></div>
                </div>
              </section>
      
              <!-- Your progress at a glance -->
              <div class="db-section-header">
                <h3 class="db-section-title">Your progress at a glance</h3>
                <span class="db-section-badge" id="dbTargetGoalSummary">Routine Goal: 4h</span>
              </div>
      
              <div class="db-kpi-grid">
                <!-- Card 1: Study Time -->
                <div class="db-kpi-card glass db-kpi--time">
                  <div class="db-kpi-head">
                    <span class="db-kpi-label">Study Time</span>
                    <div class="db-kpi-icon"><i data-lucide="clock"></i></div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="db-kpi-main">
                    <span class="db-kpi-num" id="dbKpiStudyToday"><span class="skeleton skeleton-kpi" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="sr-only">Loading study time</span></span>
                    <span class="db-kpi-sub" id="dbKpiStudySub">Goal: 4h 0m</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="db-kpi-progress">
                    <div class="db-kpi-progress-bar bar-cyan" id="dbKpiStudyProgressBar" style="width: 0%"></div>
                  </div>
                </div>
      
                <!-- Card 2: Tasks Completed -->
                <div class="db-kpi-card glass db-kpi--tasks">
                  <div class="db-kpi-head">
                    <span class="db-kpi-label">Tasks Completed</span>
                    <div class="db-kpi-icon"><i data-lucide="check-circle-2"></i></div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="db-kpi-main">
                    <span class="db-kpi-num" id="dbKpiTasksRatio"><span class="skeleton skeleton-kpi" style="width: 84px;" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="sr-only">Loading completed tasks</span></span>
                    <span class="db-kpi-sub" id="dbKpiTasksSub">Today's routine</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="db-kpi-progress">
                    <div class="db-kpi-progress-bar bar-emerald" id="dbKpiTasksProgressBar" style="width: 0%"></div>
                  </div>
                </div>
      
                <!-- Card 3: Streak Days -->
                <div class="db-kpi-card glass db-kpi--streak">
                  <div class="db-kpi-head">
                    <span class="db-kpi-label">Current Streak</span>
                    <div class="db-kpi-icon"><i data-lucide="flame"></i></div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="db-kpi-main">
                    <span class="db-kpi-num" id="dbKpiStreak"><span class="skeleton skeleton-kpi" style="width: 70px;" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="sr-only">Loading study streak</span></span>
                    <span class="db-kpi-sub">Consecutive study 🔥</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="db-kpi-progress">
                    <div class="db-kpi-progress-bar bar-amber" id="dbKpiStreakProgressBar" style="width: 0%"></div>
                  </div>
                </div>
      
                <!-- Card 4: Focus Score -->
                <div class="db-kpi-card glass db-kpi--score">
                  <div class="db-kpi-head">
                    <span class="db-kpi-label">Focus Score</span>
                    <div class="db-kpi-icon"><i data-lucide="zap"></i></div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="db-kpi-main">
                    <span class="db-kpi-num" id="dbKpiFocusScore"><span class="skeleton skeleton-kpi" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="sr-only">Loading focus score</span></span>
                    <span class="db-kpi-sub" id="dbKpiScoreSub">Points earned</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="db-kpi-progress">
                    <div class="db-kpi-progress-bar bar-blue" id="dbKpiScoreProgressBar" style="width: 0%"></div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
      
              <!-- 3. Two-Column Core Workspaces (Today's Plan + Focus Timer) -->
              <div class="db-core-grid">
                <!-- Left: Today's Study Plan -->
                <div class="db-plan-card glass">
                  <div class="db-card-head">
                    <div class="db-card-title-group">
                      <i data-lucide="calendar-check" class="db-title-icon"></i>
                      <h3 class="db-card-heading">Today's Study Plan</h3>
                    </div>
                    <button class="db-action-link" type="button" onclick="activateTab('routine', true)" title="Open Routine Page">
                      <span>View Routine</span> <i data-lucide="arrow-right"></i>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div class="db-plan-timeline" id="dbTodayPlanTimeline" aria-busy="true">
                    <span class="sr-only" role="status" aria-live="polite">Loading today's study plan</span>
                    <div class="skeleton skeleton-plan-row" aria-hidden="true"></div>
                    <div class="skeleton skeleton-plan-row" aria-hidden="true"></div>
                    <div class="skeleton skeleton-plan-row" aria-hidden="true"></div>
                  </div>
                </div>
      
                <!-- Right: shared Tracker timer -->
                <div class="db-timer-card glass" id="dbTimerCard">
                  <div class="db-card-head">
                    <div class="db-card-title-group">
                      <i data-lucide="timer" class="db-title-icon"></i>
                      <h3 class="db-card-heading">Study Tracker</h3>
                    </div>
                    <button class="db-action-link" id="dbTimerOpenTracker" type="button" title="Open the full Tracker page">
                      <span>Open Tracker</span> <i data-lucide="arrow-up-right"></i>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div class="db-timer-modes" aria-label="Study or break timer">
                    <button class="db-timer-mode-btn active" data-dashboard-timer-mode="study" type="button">Study</button>
                    <button class="db-timer-mode-btn" data-dashboard-timer-mode="break" type="button">Break</button>
                  </div>
                  <div class="db-timer-subject-row" data-dashboard-study-control>
                    <select id="dbTimerSubjectSelect" aria-label="Study subject"></select>
                    <input id="dbTimerCustomSubject" type="text" placeholder="Enter a subject" hidden>
                  </div>
                  <div class="db-timer-subject-row" data-dashboard-break-control hidden>
                    <select id="dbTimerBreakReason" aria-label="Break reason">
                      <option value="Refreshment">Refreshment</option>
                      <option value="Meal">Meal</option>
                      <option value="Walk">Walk</option>
                      <option value="Prayer or Mindfulness">Prayer or Mindfulness</option>
                      <option value="Other">Other</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                  <div class="db-timer-modes db-timer-durations" data-dashboard-study-control aria-label="Study duration">
                    <button class="db-timer-mode-btn active" data-dashboard-timer-duration="0" type="button">Stopwatch</button>
                    <button class="db-timer-mode-btn" data-dashboard-timer-duration="15" type="button">15m</button>
                    <button class="db-timer-mode-btn" data-dashboard-timer-duration="25" type="button">25m</button>
                    <button class="db-timer-mode-btn" data-dashboard-timer-duration="45" type="button">45m</button>
                    <button class="db-timer-mode-btn" data-dashboard-timer-duration="60" type="button">60m</button>
                  </div>
                  <div class="db-timer-modes db-timer-durations" data-dashboard-break-control hidden aria-label="Break duration">
                    <button class="db-timer-mode-btn active" data-dashboard-timer-duration="5" type="button">5m</button>
                    <button class="db-timer-mode-btn" data-dashboard-timer-duration="10" type="button">10m</button>
                    <button class="db-timer-mode-btn" data-dashboard-timer-duration="15" type="button">15m</button>
                    <button class="db-timer-mode-btn" data-dashboard-timer-duration="20" type="button">20m</button>
                    <button class="db-timer-mode-btn" data-dashboard-timer-duration="30" type="button">30m</button>
                  </div>
                  <div class="db-timer-ring-container">
                    <svg class="db-timer-svg" viewBox="0 0 200 200">
                      <circle class="db-timer-track" cx="100" cy="100" r="82" fill="none" stroke-width="8"></circle>
                    </svg>
                    <div class="db-timer-center-content">
                      <div class="db-timer-digits" id="dbTimerDigits">00:00:00</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="db-timer-actions">
                    <button class="db-timer-btn-start" id="dbTimerStartBtn" type="button">
                      <i data-lucide="play"></i> <span>Start Studying</span>
                    </button>
                    <button class="db-timer-btn-start db-timer-btn-stop" id="dbTimerStopBtn" type="button" hidden>
                      <i data-lucide="square"></i> <span>Finish Session</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
      
            </div>
            <!-- END DASHBOARD OVERVIEW -->
      
          </section>
      
          <!-- ===== ROUTINE PAGE ===== -->
          <section class="panel" id="panel-routine">
            <div class="home-container">
      
              <!-- Full-Width Daily Study Routine Card -->
              <section class="home-routine-card glass" id="homeRoutineSection">
                <div class="routine-card-header">
                  <div class="routine-hero-copy routine-title-box">
                    <div class="routine-title-icon">
                      <i data-lucide="calendar-check"></i>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <h2 class="section-title routine-main-title" style="margin:0;">Daily Study Routine</h2>
                      <span class="routine-lead routine-autosave-lead"><i data-lucide="check-circle-2"></i> Auto-saved permanently</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
      
                  <div class="routine-top-actions">
                    <!-- Month & Year display placeholder (hidden in Day mode) -->
                    <div class="routine-month-badge" id="routineMonthPlaceholder" title="Current viewing month & year" style="display:none;">
                      <i data-lucide="calendar"></i>
                      <span id="routineMonthYearText"></span>
                    </div>
      
                    <!-- Month Selector controls (visible ONLY in Monthly Overview mode) -->
                    <div id="routineMonthSelectWrap" class="routine-month-select-wrap" style="display:none;">
                      <button type="button" class="month-nav-btn" id="routinePrevMonthBtn" title="Previous Month" aria-label="Previous Month">
                        <i data-lucide="chevron-left"></i>
                      </button>
                      <div class="routine-month-select-inner">
                        <i data-lucide="calendar-range" class="routine-month-select-icon"></i>
                        <select id="monthDropdown" class="routine-month-dropdown" aria-label="Select Month"></select>
                      </div>
                      <button type="button" class="month-nav-btn" id="routineNextMonthBtn" title="Next Month" aria-label="Next Month">
                        <i data-lucide="chevron-right"></i>
                      </button>
                    </div>
      
                    <!-- Quick Jump to Today button (hidden as requested) -->
                    <button type="button" class="pill routine-today-btn is-today" id="routineGoTodayBtn" title="Jump to today's routine" style="display:none;">
                      <i data-lucide="calendar-check"></i> <span>Today</span>
                    </button>
      
                    <!-- Segmented Group Button (Daily vs Monthly) -->
                    <div class="routine-mode-toggle-group segmented-toggle-group">
                      <button type="button" class="pill btn-mode-switch active" id="dbdRoutineBtn" title="Daily routine view">
                        <i data-lucide="calendar"></i> <span>Daily</span>
                      </button>
                      <button type="button" class="pill btn-mode-switch" id="monthlyRoutineBtn" title="Toggle monthly overview list">
                        <i data-lucide="calendar-days"></i> <span>Monthly</span>
                      </button>
                    </div>
      
                    <!-- Compact Header Action Buttons -->
                    <div class="routine-actions" style="display:none;"></div>
                  </div>
                </div>
      
                <!-- Integrated Calendar Date Slider -->
                <div class="date-slider-row">
                  <button class="date-nav-btn" id="datePrevBtn" title="Previous Day" aria-label="Previous day"><i
                      data-lucide="chevron-left"></i></button>
                  <div class="date-slider" id="dateSlider"></div>
                  <button class="date-nav-btn" id="dateNextBtn" title="Next Day" aria-label="Next day"><i
                      data-lucide="chevron-right"></i></button>
                </div>
      
                <!-- Routine Table View -->
                <div class="routine-card" id="routineCardWrap"></div>
                
                <!-- Monthly Schedule View (Hidden by default) -->
                <div id="monthlyRoutineView" class="monthly-routines" hidden></div>
                
                <!-- Hidden anchor for JS compatibility -->
                <span id="routineSaveNote" style="display:none;"></span>
              </section>
            </div>
          </section>
      
          <!-- ===== TRACKER & FOCUS COMBINED ===== -->
          <section class="panel" id="panel-tracker">
            <h2 class="section-title">Study Tracker & Focus Mode</h2>
      
            <div class="tracker-top">
              <div class="session-card glass">
                <button class="db-action-link tracker-dashboard-link" type="button" onclick="activateTab('home', true)" title="Use the shared timer from Dashboard">
                  <i data-lucide="layout-dashboard"></i><span>Dashboard timer</span>
                </button>
                <div class="timer-mode-selector segmented-toggle-group" id="timerModeSelector" aria-label="Choose timer mode">
                  <button class="chip timer-mode-chip btn-mode-switch active" data-mode="study" type="button">
                    <i data-lucide="book-open"></i> <span>Study</span>
                  </button>
                  <button class="chip timer-mode-chip btn-mode-switch" data-mode="break" type="button">
                    <i data-lucide="coffee"></i> <span>Break</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
                <div class="session-row" id="studySubjectRow">
                  <select id="sessionSubject" aria-label="Select Focus Subject"></select>
                  <input type="text" id="sessionCustomSubject" placeholder="Or enter new subject" style="display:none;">
                </div>
      
                <div class="session-row" id="breakReasonRow" hidden>
                  <select id="breakReason" aria-label="Break reason">
                    <option value="Refreshment">Refreshment</option>
                    <option value="Meal">Meal</option>
                    <option value="Walk">Walk</option>
                    <option value="Prayer or Mindfulness">Prayer or Mindfulness</option>
                    <option value="Other">Other</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div class="timer-duration-selector" id="timerDurationSelector" aria-label="Select timer duration">
                  <div class="timer-duration-group" id="studyDurationOptions">
                    <button class="chip timer-dur-chip active" data-duration="0" type="button">Stopwatch</button>
                    <button class="chip timer-dur-chip" data-duration="15" type="button">15m</button>
                    <button class="chip timer-dur-chip" data-duration="25" type="button">25m (Pomodoro)</button>
                    <button class="chip timer-dur-chip" data-duration="45" type="button">45m Deep Work</button>
                    <button class="chip timer-dur-chip" data-duration="60" type="button">60m</button>
                  </div>
                  <div class="timer-duration-group" id="breakDurationOptions" hidden>
                    <button class="chip timer-dur-chip active" data-duration="5" type="button">5m</button>
                    <button class="chip timer-dur-chip" data-duration="10" type="button">10m</button>
                    <button class="chip timer-dur-chip" data-duration="15" type="button">15m</button>
                    <button class="chip timer-dur-chip" data-duration="20" type="button">20m</button>
                    <button class="chip timer-dur-chip" data-duration="30" type="button">30m</button>
                  </div>

          padding: 3px 5px;
          color: var(--text-soft);
          border-radius: 6px;
          line-height: 1;
          display: inline-flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          transition: all .2s ease;
        }
      
        .session-item .s-del-btn svg {
          width: 12px;
          height: 12px;
          display: block;
        }
      
        .session-item .s-del-btn:hover {
          color: #f43f5e;
          background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.15);
        }
      
        .session-item .s-progress {
          width: 100%;

        .session-item .s-progress-track {
          height: 7px;
          border-radius: 999px;
          background: var(--surface-strong);
          overflow: hidden;
        }
      
        .session-item .s-progress-fill {
          height: 100%;
          border-radius: 999px;
          background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent2), var(--accent1));
        }
      
        .session-item .s-meta {
          color: var(--text-soft);
          font-size: 12px;
        }
      
        .subject-bars {
          display: flex;
          flex-direction: column;
          gap: 10px;
        }
      
        .subj-bar-row {
          font-size: 13px;
        }
      
        .subj-bar-label {
          display: flex;
          justify-content: space-between;
          margin-bottom: 5px;
          color: var(--text-soft);
        }
      
        .subj-bar-track {
          height: 9px;
          border-radius: 999px;
          background: var(--surface-strong);
          overflow: hidden;
        }
      
        .subj-bar-fill {
          height: 100%;
          border-radius: 999px;
          background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent2), var(--accent1));
          transition: width .5s ease;
        }
      
        .week-chart {
          display: flex;
          align-items: flex-end;
          gap: 8px;
          height: 120px;
          padding-top: 10px;
        }
      
        .week-col {
          flex: 1;
          display: flex;
          flex-direction: column;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: flex-end;
          gap: 6px;
          height: 100%;
        }
      
        .week-bar {
          width: 100%;
          max-width: 26px;
          border-radius: 6px 6px 3px 3px;
          background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent2), var(--accent1));
          transition: height .5s ease;
        }
      
        .week-bar.met {
          background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--gold), var(--accent2));
        }
      
        .week-day-label {
          font-size: 11px;
          color: var(--text-soft);
        }
      
        .review-custom-range {
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          gap: 10px;
          flex-wrap: wrap;
          margin-bottom: 16px;
          font-size: 13px;
          color: var(--text-soft);
        }
      
        .review-custom-range input[type=date] {
          padding: 8px 12px;
          border-radius: 10px;
          border: 1px solid var(--border);
          background: var(--surface);
          color: var(--text);
          font-family: var(--font-sans);
          font-size: 13.5px;
        }
      
        .review-chart-3d {
          perspective: 600px;
          overflow-x: auto;
          padding-bottom: 6px;
        }
      
        .review-chart-3d .bars-row {
          display: flex;
          align-items: flex-end;
          gap: 10px;
          height: 170px;
          padding: 14px 6px 0;
          transform: rotateX(16deg);
          transform-style: preserve-3d;
          min-width: min-content;
        }
      
        .review-bar-col {
          flex: 1;
          min-width: 26px;
          display: flex;
          flex-direction: column;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: flex-end;
          height: 100%;
        }
      
        .review-bar {
          width: 100%;
          max-width: 32px;
          border-radius: 6px 6px 2px 2px;
          background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent2), var(--accent1));
          box-shadow: 4px 6px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), inset 0 0 12px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
          transition: height .5s ease;
          position: relative;
        }
      
        .review-bar.met {
          background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--gold), var(--accent2));
        }
      
        .review-bar-label {
          font-size: 10.5px;
          color: var(--text-soft);
          margin-top: 8px;
          white-space: nowrap;
        }
      
      
        /* 24-Hour Activity Tracker Grid */
        .activity-24h-grid {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr));
          gap: 14px;
        }
      
        .activity-box {
          padding: 16px;
          border-radius: 14px;
          background: var(--surface-strong);
          border: 1px solid var(--border);
          display: flex;
          flex-direction: column;
          gap: 6px;
        }
      
        .activity-label {
          font-size: 12.5px;
          color: var(--text-soft);
        }
      
        .activity-value {
          font-family: var(--font-display);
          font-size: 19px;
          font-weight: 700;
          color: var(--text);
          line-height: 1.2;
        }
      
      
      
        /* ===== First-Time User Onboarding Subject Modal ===== */
        .onboarding-card {
          border-radius: 20px;
          background: var(--surface-strong);
          border: 1px solid var(--border);
          box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55), 0 0 40px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.18);
        }
      
        .onboarding-subject-grid {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr));
          gap: 10px;
        }
      
        .onboarding-subject-item {
          display: flex;
          align-items: flex-start;
          gap: 12px;
          padding: 12px 14px;
          border-radius: 12px;
          background: var(--surface);
          border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
          cursor: pointer;
          transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
          position: relative;
          user-select: none;
        }
      
        .onboarding-subject-item:hover {
          border-color: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.5);
          background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.06);
          transform: translateY(-1px);
        }
      
        .onboarding-subject-item.selected {
          border-color: var(--accent1);
          background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.12);
          box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15);
        }
      
        .onboarding-checkbox {
          width: 17px;
          height: 17px;
          margin-top: 3px;
          accent-color: var(--accent1);
          cursor: pointer;
          flex-shrink: 0;
        }
      
        .onboarding-item-info {
          display: flex;
          flex-direction: column;
          gap: 2px;
          flex: 1;
          min-width: 0;
        }
      
        .onboarding-item-title {
          font-size: 13.5px;
          font-weight: 600;
          color: var(--text);
          line-height: 1.25;
        }
      
        .onboarding-item-alias {
          font-size: 11.5px;
          color: var(--accent2);
          font-weight: 500;
        }
      
        .onboarding-item-desc {
          font-size: 11px;
          color: var(--text-soft);
          margin-top: 3px;
          line-height: 1.35;
        }
      
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
          .onboarding-subject-grid {
            grid-template-columns: 1fr;
          }
          .onboarding-card {
            max-height: 94vh;
            width: 96%;
          }
        }

        .clock-orb {

          position: relative;
          box-shadow: 0 0 0 rgba(139, 124, 255, 0);

        .clock-orb::before {
          content: "";
          position: absolute;
          inset: -3px;
          border-radius: 50%;
          z-index: -1;
          background: conic-gradient(from 0deg, var(--accent1), var(--accent2), var(--gold), var(--accent1));

        .clock-orb::after {

        .clock-orb.active {

            max-height: 94vh;
            width: 96%;

          box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.45);
        }
      
        html[data-theme="light"] .heatmap-cell.lvl-0 {
          background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
          border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
        }
      
        html[data-theme="light"] .heatmap-cell.lvl-1 {
          background: rgba(8, 145, 178, 0.25);
        }
      
        html[data-theme="light"] .heatmap-cell.lvl-2 {
          background: rgba(8, 145, 178, 0.52);
        }
      
        html[data-theme="light"] .heatmap-cell.lvl-3 {
          background: rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.8);
        }
      
        html[data-theme="light"] .heatmap-cell.lvl-4 {
          background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0891b2, #4f46e5);
        }
      
        .heatmap-footer {
          display: flex;
          justify-content: space-between;
          align-items: center;
          flex-wrap: wrap;
          gap: 8px;
          margin-top: 10px;
          font-size: 11.5px;
          color: var(--text-soft);
        }
      
        .heatmap-legend {
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          gap: 4px;
          font-size: 11px;
          color: var(--text-muted);
        }
      
        .heatmap-legend .heatmap-cell {
          cursor: default;
        }
        .heatmap-legend .heatmap-cell:hover {
          transform: none;
        }
      
        /* Routine Empty State Card */
        .routine-empty-card {
          padding: 36px 20px;
          text-align: center;
          border-radius: 16px;
          background: var(--surface);
          border: 1px dashed var(--border);
          margin: 10px 0;
        }
      
        .routine-empty-icon {
          width: 48px;
          height: 48px;
          border-radius: 14px;
          background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.12);
          color: var(--accent1);
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          margin: 0 auto 12px;
        }
      
        .routine-empty-icon svg,
        .routine-empty-icon .lucide {
          width: 24px;
          height: 24px;
        }
      
        .routine-empty-card h4 {
          font-family: var(--font-display);
          font-size: 16px;
          margin: 0 0 6px;
          color: var(--text);
        }
      
        .routine-empty-card p {
          font-size: 13px;
          color: var(--text-soft);
          margin: 0 auto 18px;
          max-width: 420px;
          line-height: 1.45;
        }
      
        .routine-empty-actions {
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          gap: 10px;
          flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
      
        /* Header Actions */
        .header-actions,
        .brand-actions,
        .watch-actions {
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          gap: 8px;
          flex-shrink: 0;
          flex-wrap: nowrap;
          border: none;
          padding: 0;
        }
      
        .icon-action-btn,
        .watch-action {
          width: 38px;
          height: 38px;
          border-radius: 12px;
          background: var(--surface);
          border: 1px solid var(--border);
          color: var(--text-soft);
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          cursor: pointer;
          position: relative;
          padding: 0;
          transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
          backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
          -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
        }
      
        .icon-action-btn i[data-lucide],
        .icon-action-btn svg,
        .watch-action i[data-lucide],
        .watch-action svg {
          width: 17px;
          height: 17px;
          color: inherit;
          stroke: currentColor;
          transition: transform 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
        }
      
        .icon-action-btn:hover,
        .watch-action:hover {
          background: var(--surface-hover);
          border-color: var(--accent1);
          color: var(--text);
          transform: translateY(-1px);
          box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.22);
        }
      
        .icon-action-btn:active,
        .watch-action:active {
          transform: scale(0.94);
        }
      
        html[data-theme="light"] .icon-action-btn,
        html[data-theme="light"] .watch-action {
          background: var(--surface);
          border-color: var(--border);
          color: var(--text-soft);
        }
      
        html[data-theme="light"] .icon-action-btn:hover,
        html[data-theme="light"] .watch-action:hover {
          background: #ffffff;
          border-color: var(--accent1);
          color: var(--accent1);
          box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.16);
        }
      
        .watch-action:focus-visible,
        .icon-action-btn:focus-visible {
          outline: 2px solid var(--accent1);
          outline-offset: 2px;
        }
      
        .timer-mode-selector {
          display: inline-flex;
          align-items: center;
          gap: 4px;
          margin-top: 10px;
          padding: 4px;
          border: 1px solid var(--border);
          border-radius: 14px;
          background: var(--surface-strong);
        }
      
        .timer-mode-chip {
          min-width: 82px;
          padding: 7px 14px;
          border: 0;
          border-radius: 10px;
          background: transparent;
          color: var(--text-soft);
          cursor: pointer;
          font: 700 12px var(--font-sans);
        }
      
        .timer-mode-chip.active {
          background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent1), var(--accent2));
          color: #fff;
          box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.2);
        }
      
        .timer-duration-selector {
          display: flex;
          justify-content: center;
          gap: 6px;
          margin-top: 8px;
          flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
      
        .timer-duration-group {
          display: flex;
          justify-content: center;
          gap: 6px;
          flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
      
        .timer-duration-group[hidden] {
          display: none;
        }
      
        .session-row[hidden],
        .timer-duration-selector[hidden] {
          display: none !important;
        }
      
        #breakDurationOptions .chip.active {
          background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold), var(--accent3));
        }
      
        .routine-view-btn {
          min-width: 118px;
          justify-content: center;
        }
      
      
        /* ===== Tracker ===== */
        .tracker-top {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(0, 0.85fr);
          align-items: stretch;   /* ← FIX: forces both cards to equal height */
          gap: 18px;
          margin-bottom: 22px;
        }
      
      /* ================================================================
         Tracker V2 — focus cockpit
         ================================================================ */
      #panel-tracker {
        position: relative;
      }
      
      #panel-tracker > .section-title {
        font-size: clamp(24px, 3vw, 34px);
        letter-spacing: -.04em;
        margin-bottom: 20px;
      }
      
      #panel-tracker > .section-title::after {
        content: 'Build consistency, one focused session at a time.';
        display: block;
        margin-top: 8px;
        color: var(--text-soft);
        font: 500 13px/1.5 var(--font-sans);
        letter-spacing: 0;
      }
      
      #panel-tracker .session-card,
      #panel-tracker .target-card,
      #panel-tracker > .glass {
        border-radius: 24px;
        border-color: rgba(148,163,184,.18);
        box-shadow: 0 16px 38px rgba(2,6,23,.14), inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.06);
      }
      
      #panel-tracker .session-card {
        padding: 26px;
        background:
          radial-gradient(circle at 50% 22%, rgba(99,102,241,.13), transparent 36%),
          var(--surface);
      }
      
      #panel-tracker .target-card {
        padding: 26px;
        background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(6,182,212,.10), var(--surface) 54%);
      }
      
      #panel-tracker .timer-mode-selector,
      #panel-tracker .timer-duration-selector {
        padding: 5px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 14px;
        background: rgba(255,255,255,.025);
      }
      
      #panel-tracker .clock-orb {
        width: min(260px, 70vw);
        height: min(260px, 70vw);
        margin-inline: auto;
        border: 1px solid rgba(103,232,249,.3);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 12px rgba(6,182,212,.035), 0 0 60px rgba(6,182,212,.14);
      }
      
      #panel-tracker .timer-display {
        font-size: clamp(32px, 5vw, 48px);
        letter-spacing: -.06em;
      }
      
      #panel-tracker .activity-box,
      #panel-tracker .heatmap-stat-pill {
        border-radius: 16px;
        border-color: rgba(148,163,184,.18);
        background: rgba(255,255,255,.035);
      }
      
      #panel-tracker .progress-track {
        height: 10px;
        border-radius: 99px;
      }
      
      .subj-plan-row .subj-bar-track {
        position: relative;
      }
      
      .subject-plan-help {
        margin: -6px 0 14px;
        color: var(--text-muted);
        font-size: 11px;
      }
      
      .subj-plan-track,
      .subj-plan-fill {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        height: 100%;
        border-radius: inherit;
      }
      
      .subj-plan-track {
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent2) 18%, var(--surface-strong));
      }
      
      .subj-plan-fill {
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent2), var(--accent1));
        transition: width .5s ease;
      }
      .subj-plan-fill {
        stroke-dashoffset: 0;
        stroke-dasharray: 1000;
        animation: barFill 1s ease-out forwards;
      }
      
      @keyframes barFill {
        from {
          stroke-dashoffset: 1000;
        }
        to {
          stroke-dashoffset: 0;
        }
      }
      
      @keyframes barFill {
        from {
          width: 0%;
        }
        to {
;
        }
      }
      
      .subj-plan-details {
        margin-top: 4px;
        color: var(--text-muted);
        font-size: 11px;
      }
      
      .subj-plan-status {
        padding: 2px 7px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        font-size: 10px;
        font-weight: 700;
      }
      
      .subj-plan-status--complete {
        color: #34d399;
        border-color: rgba(52, 211, 153, .35);
        background: rgba(16, 185, 129, .1);
      }
      
      .subj-plan-status--not-complete {
        color: #fbbf8a;
        border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, .3);
        background: rgba(245, 158, 11, .1);
      }
      
      .subj-plan-status--in-progress,
      .subj-plan-status--upcoming,
      .subj-plan-status--time-not-set,
      .subj-plan-status--unplanned {
        color: var(--text-soft);
      }
      
      @media (max-width: 700px) {
        #panel-tracker .session-card,
        #panel-tracker .target-card,
        #panel-tracker > .glass { padding: 18px; border-radius: 18px; }
      }
      
        @media (max-width:850px) {
          .tracker-top {
            grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            align-items: start; /* stacked on mobile — no forced equal height */
          }
        }
      
        /* ── Left column: Focus / Timer card ── */
        .session-card {
          min-width: 0;
          height: 100%;           /* ← FIX: fill the full grid row height */
          box-sizing: border-box;
          padding: 22px;
          display: flex;
          flex-direction: column;
          gap: 12px;
        }
      
        /* ── Right column: Goal / Progress card ── (single canonical rule below at .target-card) */
      
        .session-row {
          display: flex;
          gap: 10px;
          flex-wrap: wrap;
          align-items: center;
        }
      
        .session-row input[type=text] {
          flex: 1;
          min-width: 160px;
          padding: 10px 14px;
          border-radius: 10px;
          border: 1px solid var(--border);
          background: var(--surface);
          color: var(--text);
          font-family: var(--font-sans);
          font-size: 14px;
        }
      
        .session-row select {
          flex: 1;
          min-width: 160px;
        }
      
        .session-row input:focus {
          outline: none;
          box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent1);
        }
      
        .timer-display,
        #timerDisplay {
          font-family: var(--font-display);
          font-size: 34px !important;
          font-weight: 800 !important;
          text-align: center !important;
          letter-spacing: 1.5px !important;
          color: var(--text) !important;
          -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--text) !important;
          background: none !important;
          font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums !important;
          position: relative;
          z-index: 5;
          margin: 0;
          padding: 0;
          line-height: 1.2;
          display: block;
          border: none !important;
          box-shadow: none !important;
        }
      
        .clock-orb {
          width: 190px;
          height: 190px;
          margin: 20px auto 8px;
          border-radius: 50%;
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          background: var(--surface-strong);
          position: relative;
          box-shadow: 0 0 0 rgba(139, 124, 255, 0);
          transition: box-shadow .5s ease;
          flex-shrink: 0;
        }
      
        .clock-orb::before {
          content: "";
          position: absolute;
          inset: -3px;
          border-radius: 50%;
          z-index: -1;
          background: conic-gradient(from 0deg, var(--accent1), var(--accent2), var(--gold), var(--accent1));
          opacity: 0.55;
          filter: blur(0.5px);
        }
      
        .clock-orb::after {
          content: "";
          position: absolute;
          inset: 2px;
          border-radius: 50%;
          background: var(--bg);
          z-index: -1;
        }
      
        .clock-orb.active {
          animation: orbBreathe 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
      
        .clock-orb.active::before {
          animation: spin 5s linear infinite;
        }
      
        @keyframes spin {
          to {
            transform: rotate(360deg);
          }
        }
      
        @keyframes orbBreathe {
      
          0%,
          100% {
            box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(139, 124, 255, 0.22);
          }
      
          50% {
            box-shadow: 0 0 52px rgba(139, 124, 255, 0.55);
          }
        }
      
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
          .clock-orb.active {
            animation: none;
          }
      
          .clock-orb.active::before {
            animation: none;
          }
        }
      
        .timer-sub {
          text-align: center;
          color: var(--text-soft);
          font-size: 13px;
          margin-bottom: 14px;
          min-height: 18px;
        }
      
        .timer-dot {
          display: inline-block;
          width: 9px;
          height: 9px;
          border-radius: 50%;
          background: var(--accent3);
          margin-right: 6px;
          animation: pulse 1.1s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
      
        @keyframes pulse {
      
          0%,
          100% {
            opacity: 1;
          }
      
          50% {
            opacity: 0.25;
          }
        }
      
        .session-btn-row {
          display: flex;
          justify-content: center;
          gap: 10px;
          margin-top: 6px;
        }
      
        /* ── Right column: Goal / Progress card ── */
        .target-card {
          padding: 22px;
          display: flex;
          flex-direction: column;
          gap: 14px;
          min-width: 0;
          width: 100%;
          height: 100%;           /* ← FIX: fill the full grid row height */
          box-sizing: border-box;
          overflow-y: auto;       /* ← FIX: scroll internally if content overflows */
        }
      
        .target-row {
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          gap: 10px;
        }
      
        .target-row input[type=number] {
          width: 80px;
          padding: 8px 10px;
          border-radius: 10px;
          border: 1px solid var(--border);
          background: var(--surface);
          color: var(--text);
          font-family: var(--font-sans);
          font-size: 14px;
        }
      
        .progress-track {
          height: 14px;
          border-radius: 999px;
          background: var(--surface-strong);
          overflow: hidden;
          border: 1px solid var(--border);
        }
      
        .progress-fill {
          height: 100%;
          border-radius: 999px;
          background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent1), var(--accent2));
          transition: width .5s ease;
        }
      
        .progress-label {
          display: flex;
          justify-content: space-between;
          font-size: 12.5px;
          color: var(--text-soft);
        }
      
        .verdict {
          font-family: var(--font-display);
          font-weight: 600;
          font-size: 14.5px;
          padding: 10px 14px;
          border-radius: 10px;
          background: var(--surface-strong);
          border: 1px solid var(--border);
        }
      
        .streak-line {
          font-size: 13px;
          color: var(--text-soft);
        }
      
        .tracker-routine-preview {
          margin-top: 6px;
          padding-top: 12px;
          border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
          display: flex;
          flex-direction: column;
          gap: 8px;
          width: 100%;
          min-width: 0;
          box-sizing: border-box;
          flex: 1 1 auto;
          overflow: visible; /* ← FIX: was 'hidden' which silently clipped routine items */
        }
      
        .tracker-routine-title {
          font-size: 12.5px;
          font-weight: 700;
          color: var(--text-soft);
          text-transform: uppercase;
          letter-spacing: 0.4px;
        }
      
        .tracker-routine-item {
          padding: 10px 11px;
          border-radius: 12px;
          border: 1px solid var(--border);
          background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--surface-strong), var(--surface));
          width: 100%;
          box-sizing: border-box;
        }
      
        .tracker-routine-details {
          min-width: 0;
        }
      
        .tracker-routine-subject-row {
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: space-between;
          gap: 8px;
          margin-bottom: 6px;
        }
      
        .tracker-routine-subject {
          font-size: 13px;
          font-weight: 700;
          color: var(--text);
        }
      
        .tracker-routine-time {
          font-size: 12px;
          font-weight: 700;
          color: var(--accent2);
          white-space: nowrap;
        }
      
        .tracker-routine-progress {
          width: 100%;
        }
      
        .tracker-routine-track {
          height: 8px;
          border-radius: 999px;
          background: var(--surface-strong);
          overflow: hidden;
        }
      
        .tracker-routine-fill {
          height: 100%;
          border-radius: 999px;
          background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent2), var(--accent1));
        }
      
        .sessions-list {
          display: flex;
          flex-direction: column;
          gap: 8px;
          margin-top: 4px;
          flex: 1 1 0;            /* ← FIX: grow to fill remaining card height */
          min-height: 0;          /* required for flex shrink to work */
          max-height: 320px;      /* reasonable cap so it doesn't balloon on tall screens */
          overflow-y: auto;
          padding-right: 4px;
        }
      
      
        .session-item {
          display: flex;
          flex-direction: column;
          align-items: flex-start;
          gap: 8px;
          padding: 10px 11px;
          border-radius: 12px;
          border: 1px solid var(--border);
          background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--surface-strong), var(--surface));
          font-size: 13.5px;
          transition: transform .15s ease, border-color .15s ease;
          width: 100%;
          box-sizing: border-box;
          box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
        }
      
        .session-item:hover {
          transform: translateY(-1px);
          border-color: var(--accent1);
        }
      
        .session-item-header {
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: space-between;
          width: 100%;
          gap: 8px;
        }
      
        .session-item .s-subject {
          font-weight: 700;
          color: var(--text);
          font-size: 13px;
          line-height: 1.3;
        }
      
        .session-item .s-badge {
          font-size: 11px;
          font-weight: 700;
          padding: 4px 8px;
          border-radius: 8px;
          color: var(--accent2);
          background: rgba(51, 224, 199, 0.12);
          white-space: nowrap;
        }
      
        .session-item .s-del-btn {
          background: transparent;
          border: none;
          cursor: pointer;
          font-size: 11px;
          padding: 3px 5px;
          color: var(--text-soft);
          border-radius: 6px;
          line-height: 1;
          display: inline-flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          transition: all .2s ease;
        }
      
        .session-item .s-del-btn svg {
          width: 12px;
          height: 12px;
          display: block;
        }
      
        .session-item .s-del-btn:hover {
          color: #f43f5e;
          background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.15);
        }
      
        .session-item .s-progress {
          width: 100%;
        }
      
        .session-item .s-progress-track {
          height: 7px;
          border-radius: 999px;
          background: var(--surface-strong);
          overflow: hidden;
        }
      
        .session-item .s-progress-fill {
          height: 100%;
          border-radius: 999px;
          background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent2), var(--accent1));
        }
      
        .session-item .s-meta {
          color: var(--text-soft);
          font-size: 12px;
        }
      
        .subject-bars {
          display: flex;
          flex-direction: column;
          gap: 10px;
        }
      
        .subj-bar-row {
          font-size: 13px;
        }
      
        .subj-bar-label {
          display: flex;
          justify-content: space-between;
          margin-bottom: 5px;
          color: var(--text-soft);
        }
      
        .subj-bar-track {
          height: 9px;
          border-radius: 999px;
          background: var(--surface-strong);
          overflow: hidden;
        }
      
        .subj-bar-fill {
          height: 100%;
          border-radius: 999px;
          background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent2), var(--accent1));
          transition: width .5s ease;
        }
      
        .week-chart {
          display: flex;
          align-items: flex-end;
          gap: 8px;
          height: 120px;
          padding-top: 10px;
        }
      
        .week-col {
          flex: 1;
          display: flex;
          flex-direction: column;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: flex-end;
          gap: 6px;
          height: 100%;
        }
      
        .week-bar {
          width: 100%;
          max-width: 26px;
          border-radius: 6px 6px 3px 3px;
          background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent2), var(--accent1));
          transition: height .5s ease;
        }
      
        .week-bar.met {
          background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--gold), var(--accent2));
        }
      
        .week-day-label {
          font-size: 11px;
          color: var(--text-soft);
        }
      
        .review-custom-range {
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          gap: 10px;
          flex-wrap: wrap;
          margin-bottom: 16px;
          font-size: 13px;
          color: var(--text-soft);
        }
      
        .review-custom-range input[type=date] {
          padding: 8px 12px;
          border-radius: 10px;
          border: 1px solid var(--border);
          background: var(--surface);
          color: var(--text);
          font-family: var(--font-sans);
          font-size: 13.5px;
        }
      
        .review-chart-3d {
          perspective: 600px;
          overflow-x: auto;
          padding-bottom: 6px;
        }
      
        .review-chart-3d .bars-row {
          display: flex;
          align-items: flex-end;
          gap: 10px;
          height: 170px;
          padding: 14px 6px 0;
          transform: rotateX(16deg);
          transform-style: preserve-3d;
          min-width: min-content;
        }
      
        .review-bar-col {
          flex: 1;
          min-width: 26px;
          display: flex;
          flex-direction: column;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: flex-end;
          height: 100%;
        }
      
        .review-bar {
          width: 100%;
          max-width: 32px;
          border-radius: 6px 6px 2px 2px;
          background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent2), var(--accent1));
          box-shadow: 4px 6px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), inset 0 0 12px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
          transition: height .5s ease;
          position: relative;
        }
      
        .review-bar.met {
          background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--gold), var(--accent2));
        }
      
        .review-bar-label {
          font-size: 10.5px;
          color: var(--text-soft);
          margin-top: 8px;
          white-space: nowrap;
        }
      
      
        /* 24-Hour Activity Tracker Grid */
        .activity-24h-grid {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr));
          gap: 14px;
        }
      
        .activity-box {
          padding: 16px;
          border-radius: 14px;
          background: var(--surface-strong);
          border: 1px solid var(--border);
          display: flex;
          flex-direction: column;
          gap: 6px;
        }
      
        .activity-label {
          font-size: 12.5px;
          color: var(--text-soft);
        }
      
        .activity-value {
          font-family: var(--font-display);
          font-size: 19px;
          font-weight: 700;
          color: var(--text);
          line-height: 1.2;
        }
      
      
      
        /* ===== First-Time User Onboarding Subject Modal ===== */
        .onboarding-card {
          border-radius: 20px;
          background: var(--surface-strong);
          border: 1px solid var(--border);
          box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55), 0 0 40px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.18);
        }
      
        .onboarding-subject-grid {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr));
          gap: 10px;
        }
      
        .onboarding-subject-item {
          display: flex;
          align-items: flex-start;
          gap: 12px;
          padding: 12px 14px;
          border-radius: 12px;
          background: var(--surface);
          border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
          cursor: pointer;
          transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
          position: relative;
          user-select: none;
        }
      
        .onboarding-subject-item:hover {
          border-color: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.5);
          background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.06);
          transform: translateY(-1px);
        }
      
        .onboarding-subject-item.selected {
          border-color: var(--accent1);
          background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.12);
          box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15);
        }
      
        .onboarding-checkbox {
          width: 17px;
          height: 17px;
          margin-top: 3px;
          accent-color: var(--accent1);
          cursor: pointer;
          flex-shrink: 0;
        }
      
        .onboarding-item-info {
          display: flex;
          flex-direction: column;
          gap: 2px;
          flex: 1;
          min-width: 0;
        }
      
        .onboarding-item-title {
          font-size: 13.5px;
          font-weight: 600;
          color: var(--text);
          line-height: 1.25;
        }
      
        .onboarding-item-alias {
          font-size: 11.5px;
          color: var(--accent2);
          font-weight: 500;
        }
      
        .onboarding-item-desc {
          font-size: 11px;
          color: var(--text-soft);
          margin-top: 3px;
          line-height: 1.35;
        }
      
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
          .onboarding-subject-grid {
            grid-template-columns: 1fr;
          }
          .onboarding-card {
            max-height: 94vh;
            width: 96%;
          }
        }

      function openOnboardingModal(isReset = false) {

        } else {

        badge.textContent = `${checkedCount} of ${totalCount}`;

      // Deselect All button
      const onboardingClearAllBtn = document.getElementById('onboardingClearAllBtn');

      // Confirm selection button

          const checkedInputs = Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll('.onboarding-checkbox:checked'));
          if (checkedInputs.length === 0) {
            showToast('Please select at least one subject to get started', true);
            return;
          }
      
          const selectedNames = checkedInputs.map(cb => cb.value.trim());
          const selectedCanonicals = new Set(selectedNames.map(s => canonicalSubjectName(s).toLowerCase()));
      
          if (!Array.isArray(state.deletedSubjects)) state.deletedSubjects = [];
          if (!Array.isArray(state.customSubjects)) state.customSubjects = [];
      
          // Collect all known subjects across system to ensure unselected items are removed
          const allKnown = masterSubjectList(true);
          CURRICULUM_SUBJECT_CHOICES.forEach(c => {
            if (!allKnown.some(s => canonicalSubjectName(s).toLowerCase() === canonicalSubjectName(c.name).toLowerCase())) {
              allKnown.push(c.name);
            }
          });
      
          allKnown.forEach(sub => {
            const subCanonical = canonicalSubjectName(sub).toLowerCase();
            const isSelected = selectedCanonicals.has(subCanonical);
            if (!isSelected) {
              if (!state.deletedSubjects.some(d => canonicalSubjectName(d).toLowerCase() === subCanonical)) {
                state.deletedSubjects.push(sub);
              }
              state.customSubjects = state.customSubjects.filter(c => canonicalSubjectName(c).toLowerCase() !== subCanonical);
            } else {

              if (!isDefault && !state.customSubjects.some(c => canonicalSubjectName(c).toLowerCase() === subCanonical)) {
                state.customSubjects.push(sub);
              }
            }
          });

          syncAllSubjectSelects();
          renderSubjectManager();
